Subject: Buyer mapping & next steps after discovery call

Samir — thanks again for taking the time this morning. Short recap and the two asks we discussed so we have alignment for procurement: 

Recap (30m call)
- Primary use case: multi-tenant inference for clinical summarization and batch-embedding pipeline for search.
- Main non-functional requirements: sub-100ms p99 generation for short prompts, VPC-only data path for PHI, and predictable monthly spend.
- Security gating: SOC2 evidence + encryption-at-rest and support for customer-managed KMS.

Open items / asks
1) Could you confirm who owns the budget (economic buyer) and who owns procurement/legal? We want to engage the right people early to avoid delays.
2) If you can, please introduce the procurement contact and the budget owner so we can share a high-level mutual action plan and a tailored pricing ballpark.

Next steps from our side
- I attached a one-page MAP (Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf) showing milestones, expected artifacts, and a sample timeline for a Q3 pilot.
- We'll also attach a short SOC2 summary for your security team to review.

Timing: if you can loop in procurement/budget this week we can lock a 30–45m intro with Rishi (technical + infra) and me next week and walk through acceptance criteria and the procurement checklist.

Attachment: [Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (PDF, 1 page, 98KB)]
Attachment: [SOC2-summary.pdf (PDF, 2 pages, 58KB)]

Thanks — Vanessa

Laura / Priya — great to meet you both (virtually). Very high level agenda for a 30–45m intro call (we can tailor):

1) 5m: Introductions + short business context (Samir)
2) 10m: Where Redwood fits — performance, cost model, deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private) (Vanessa)
3) 10m: Security/compliance & procurement artifacts (SOC2 summary, encryption, KMS options) (Rishi)
4) 10m: Pilot proposal & commercial frame — expected timeline, success criteria, and a sample commitment + pricing bands (Vanessa)
5) 5–10m: Qs and next steps (capture procurement redline owners + decision timeline)

What would be helpful for you both before the call: 
- A 1-page P&L-style estimate for an initial pilot and committed option (we can provide two pricing bands: pilot (no commit) vs 6–12mo reserved capacity).
- Short answers to the security questionnaire we already sent — Rishi can ping that to your security team.

If it works, how is Thursday 12 Aug at 10:00am PT for a 30m intro? If Laura prefers not to join the full 30m, she could attend first 10m for budget alignment and delegate procurement details to Priya.

I'll also drop the MAP link here: https://drive.google.com/redwood/rdw-map-aurelia (same files attached).

Thanks — looking forward.
